philosophy.title: What we are building is actually simple
philosophy.body: We do not draw conclusions for you — we just give you another angle to look at yourself. Tool results are reference points, not verdicts; guides are optional, not mandatory. You can always use just the tools without booking a guide. Guide ranking is determined by objective criteria such as ratings and availability, following public rules — the platform does not favor any individual guide.

beta.seoDescription: Join the MELE public beta and test free self-discovery tools, daily rituals, and extended readings before launch.

beta.description: This is MELE’s public testing entrance before launch. Start with free tools, complete the daily ritual, view one extended reading, and report anything confusing, broken, or worth keeping.
beta.inviteNote: Public beta is open for testing. If signup still carries an invite code, it only helps us track tester sources and does not block use.

Complete your daily ritual and view one extended reading.
Report anything confusing, broken, or surprisingly useful.

beta.questsBody: You do not need to test everything at once. Use this path to reveal real user friction.

quests.title: Step 1: Free self-discovery
quests.body: Try numerology, Human Design, Maya, or tarot first.

quests.title: Step 2: Daily rhythm
quests.body: Test daily draw, daily ritual, and the reason to return.

quests.title: Step 3: Save and explore
quests.body: Log in to review saved charts and extended readings you have opened.

beta.feedbackTitle: What public beta testers should report
beta.feedbackBody: Confusing copy, unclear buttons, cramped mobile screens, login or saved-record friction, strong readings, and weak readings are all valuable before launch.
